in_sanskrit.name: शर्वनीया

in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvaniyaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharvaniyaa is a symbol of wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge. She is revered for her ability to bestow blessings of knowledge and understanding upon her devotees.
